captions.zh: 独立层近似正交随机游走，总残差增量按 √$L$ 增长；共享权重循环同向线性累加，总残差增量按 $N$ 增长。
captions.en: Independent layers add up like a random walk and grow as √$L$; a shared block adds along one direction and grows as $N$.

captions.zh: 初始化阶段，非循环深层模型仅需 $m$_{$L$}^{−1/2} 即可保持残差流有界，而循环模型必须乘以 $N$^{−1}。
captions.en: At initialization, $m$_{$L$}^{−1/2} keeps the untied residual stream bounded, while the looped model needs $N$^{−1}.

captions.zh: 初始化阶段，64 个独立块的残差增量两两近似正交，而同一循环块执行 64 轮的增量两两正相关。
captions.en: At initialization, the increments of 64 independent stacks are nearly orthogonal, while those of one stack looped 64 times are all positively correlated.

captions.zh: 三项核心尺度关系：唯有取 $c$_{$N$} = 1/$N$ 且基础学习率与 $N$ 无关时，前向激活、特征更新与输出更新才能同时保持与 $N$ 无关。
captions.en: The three-line ledger: each quantity is a number of pieces times the size of one piece. Only with $c$_{$N$} = 1/$N$ and one learning rate for every $N$ are all three independent of $N$.

captions.zh: 网络越宽，$WU$ 越接近与 $U$ 正交且保持等范数；继续左乘 $W$ 得到的 $W$^{2}$U$、$W$^{3}$U$ 与前序向量同样近似正交。
captions.en: The wider the network, the closer $WU$ is to orthogonal to $U$ with the same length; $W$^{2}$U$ and $W$^{3}$U$ are again nearly orthogonal to the vectors before them.

captions.zh: 展开 ($I$ + $cW$)^{$N$}$U$ 对应枚举每轮走残差主干或分支的全部路径：经过 $m$ 次分支的路径在共享权重下输出完全相同的向量，而在独立权重下彼此正交。
captions.en: Expanding ($I$ + $cW$)^{$N$}$U$ lists every way of choosing trunk or branch in each loop. The paths that take the branch $m$ times give one and the same vector with shared weights, and mutually orthogonal vectors with independent weights.

captions.zh: 展开 ($I$ + $cW$)^{$N$}$U$：共享权重下同阶路径同向共线、按模长线性相加；独立权重下各路径彼此正交、按平方和合成。
captions.en: Expanding ($I$ + $cW$)^{$N$}$U$: with shared weights the terms of each order point the same way and add in length; with independent weights they add in quadrature.

captions.zh: 共享权重的总梯度为 $N$ 轮循环各自贡献之和：在线性残差模型中，任意两轮的梯度贡献均正相关，$N$ 项合成范数接近单项的 $N$ 倍。
captions.en: The gradient of the shared weights is the sum of the contributions of the $N$ loops. In the linear model the contributions of any two loops are positively correlated, so the sum of the $N$ terms is close to $N$ times as long as a single term.

captions.zh: 共享权重下，可行域收缩为唯一解 ($α$_{$N$}, $γ$_{$N$}) = (1, 0)，兼顾初始化稳定、更新有界与输出不退化；而独立层深层模型则拥有整段可行区间。
captions.en: With shared weights, only $α$_{$N$} = 1, $γ$_{$N$} = 0 keeps initialization and training stable while one step still changes the output by an amount independent of $N$; with independent layers a whole interval is feasible.

captions.zh: 固定基础学习率不变时，唯有 $N$^{−1} 残差缩放能使单步更新后的残差流变化既不随 $N$ 发散，也不随 $N$ 退化。
captions.en: With one learning rate for every $N$, only $N$^{−1} gives a one-step change that neither grows nor vanishes with $N$.

captions.zh: 唯有 Loop-μP 能让同一基础学习率跨所有循环次数与物理深度同步达到最优，并取得最低 validation loss。
captions.en: Only Loop-μP keeps one base learning rate best across loop counts and depths, and it reaches the lowest loss.

captions.zh: 训练完成后，循环模型前 $N$−1 轮残差增量依然保持高度同向，而非循环深层模型的层增量仅在相邻层间微弱相关。
captions.en: After training, the pass increments of looped models stay aligned except for the final pass, while the layer increments of an untied model align mainly with nearby layers.

captions.zh: 在 Loop-μP 参数化下，不同循环次数 $N$ 的模型训练后收敛到一致的最终残差流范数。
captions.en: Under Loop-μP, trained models with different loop counts end at a similar residual-stream norm.
